rules: one immutable result digest exists per archive work unit
checkpoint metadata binds the run, contract, R14 PASS, and Step 07 PASS
journal is regenerated from committed checkpoint rows on resume
each record carries logical request count for live ETA
only the coordinator appends committed results

unit_result.status: PASS only; failed units are never committed

freeze_manifest.archive_digest: canonical digest over all deeply verified unit identities and hashes

final_pass.verification: shallow content-addressed verification after the one-time deep scan
